act_title: The Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1980
title: The words “, while it is in session, for a total period of thirty days which may be comprised in one session or in two or more
text:
5. The words “, while it is in session, for a total period of thirty days which may be comprised in one session or in two or more

successive sessions” omitted by Act 81 of 1985, s. 15 (w.e.f. 01-05-1986).
